items.source: Returns all PersistentPropertyPaths pointing to properties on the given type that match the given Predicate.
items.translation: 返回所有指向给定类型上匹配给定Predicate的属性的PersistentPropertyPath。

items.source: Drops PersistentPropertyPaths that contain a path segment matching the given predicate.
items.translation: 返回包含与给定谓词匹配的路径段的PersistentPropertyPath集合。

items.source: Actually looks up the PersistentPropertyPaths for the given type, selection predicate and traversal guard.
items.translation: 实际上，它会为给定的类型、选择谓词和遍历守卫查找PersistentPropertyPaths。
